lifecycle_states.PROPOSED: Created by Research Operator; awaiting Approval Admin signature.
lifecycle_states.ACTIVE: Digitally signed by Approval Admin; stored in TrustedApprovalStore.
lifecycle_states.CONSUMED: Evidence successfully retrieved and vaulted; permanently non-reusable.
lifecycle_states.EXHAUSTED: Request quota exhausted without successful vaulting.
lifecycle_states.REVOKED: Explicit operator revocation recorded with reason and timestamp.
